# Dialogika

> > Dialogika is a communication skills and public speaking training hub offering beginner-friendly courses, corporate workshops, and personalized coaching across Indonesia.

Dialogika provides comprehensive public speaking and communication training through multiple formats including offline classes in Yogyakarta, online courses, private coaching, and corporate seminars. The platform serves diverse audiences from children to professionals seeking confidence building and soft skills development.

## Key Topics

## Core Programs

- [First Class - Offline Public Speaking](https://www.dialogika.co/program/first-class.html): 1+ month beginner-friendly offline public speaking course
- [Basic Plus - Online Public Speaking](https://www.dialogika.co/program/basic-plus.html): 7-week online public speaking course with satisfaction guarantee
- [First Lite - Communication Essentials](https://www.dialogika.co/program/first-lite.html): 3-session communication skills course for confidence building
- [Kids Plus - Children's Online Course](https://www.dialogika.co/program/kids-plus.html): Online public speaking course for children with confidence building focus
- [Kids Play - Children's Practice Course](https://www.dialogika.co/program/kids-play.html): Online children's public speaking course with full practice sessions
- [Private Classes - Flexible Coaching](https://www.dialogika.co/program/kids-private.html): Private online public speaking classes with flexible scheduling

## Training Solutions

- [Corporate Training Programs](https://www.dialogika.co/corporate): In-house seminars and workshops for employee soft skills development
- [Mentor Directory](https://www.dialogika.co/mentor): Directory of experienced public speaking mentors and coaches
- [Tangerang Selatan Classes](https://www.dialogika.co/page/kelas-public-speaking-tangsel): Public speaking classes in Tangerang Selatan with mentor guidance
